subsystems.name: hall
subsystems.note: ring walls t=2, iwan opening each face, solid top courses

content.text: Platform: three stepped plate tiers, white with a grey step.
Edging the terrace so the outer ring bonds: grey step ring, then a white course bridging the seam.
Hall walls: 16×16, 4 studs thick, six courses, with a deep iwan on each face.
Capping the hall: a corbel course closing inward, then a roof terrace of plates.
Parapet ring and a solid octagonal drum, four courses.
The great onion dome, stacked round plates bulging out then a hemisphere and finial.
Four domed chattris on the roof corners — one built, then stamped three times.
Four minarets: tapering round shafts with balconies and little domes.
Reworking the crown: removing my undersized dome taper to build a proper great dome.
The dome parts in this library are flat — switching to real quarter-dome bricks for a proper onion dome.
Rebuilding all the domes from round plates that actually render — great dome, chattris, minaret caps.
Terrace paths, a marble border, and raised pishtaq frames over each iwan.
Dark recessed core so each iwan reads as a deep shadowed arch.
Final detailing: tiled roof terrace ring and little finials on the drum cornice.
